title: C2 Milestone 14
completion_message: ¡Absolutamente increíble! Has superado el Milestone 14. Has llegado al pináculo del inglés corporativo y gramatical. Manejas el subjuntivo formal, la jerga de Wall Street, la teoría de juegos empresariales y la resolución de crisis diplomáticas. Tu fluidez ya es de nivel ejecutivo internacional.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone finaliza el bloque evaluando tu maestría en: 

1. The Subjunctive Mood: 
- I demand that he RESIGN (no resigns). 
- It is vital that she BE informed. 
- I suggest that you NOT SIGN it. 

2. Advanced Finance & Wall Street: 
- Bear / Bull market & Blue-chip stocks. 
- Bailout & Liquidate. 
- Capital gains & Venture capital. 
- Dividends & IPO.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 14, Executive Mastery. This exam tests the absolute peak of corporate English. First, The Subjunctive Mood. Using the base form for formal demands: I demand that he RESIGN. It is vital that she BE informed. And the negative: I suggest that you NOT SIGN it. Second, Advanced Finance. Knowing Wall Street terms like Bear and Bull markets, Blue-chip stocks, government Bailouts, how to Liquidate assets, Capital gains, Venture capital, and IPOs.

parts.visual:
3. Corporate Strategy: 
- Zero-sum game & First-mover advantage. 
- Paradigm shift & Core competency. 
- Economies of scale & Exit strategy. 
- Cannibalization & Leverage. 

4. Diplomacy & Conflict: 
- De-escalate & Pour oil on troubled waters. 
- Let cooler heads prevail. 
- Find common ground & Meet in the middle. 
- Bury the hatchet & Play devil's advocate.
parts.audio: Third, Corporate Strategy. Speaking like a CEO using concepts like Zero-sum game, First-mover advantage, Paradigm shift, Core competency, Economies of scale, and knowing your Exit strategy. Finally, Diplomacy and Conflict Resolution. How to De-escalate an argument, pour oil on troubled waters, let cooler heads prevail, find common ground, bury the hatchet, and play devil's advocate. Prove your mastery in the final exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu fluidez ejecutiva y tu precisión gramatical en este examen crucial.

questions.question: The board of directors strongly recommended that the CFO ____ immediately. (Subjuntivo).
In a ____ market, investors are pessimistic, stock prices are falling, and the economy is slowing down.
By entering the electric car market 10 years before anyone else, Tesla gained a massive ____-mover advantage.
The argument between the VP of Sales and the Lead Engineer was getting aggressive. I had to step in to ____ the situation.
It is absolutely crucial that the software ____ tested before the global launch. (Subjuntivo).
When the government gives billions of dollars to save a failing bank, it is called a financial ____.
We are losing money because we do too many things. Let's outsource HR and focus on our ____ competency: manufacturing.
Everyone is too angry right now. Let's pause the meeting and let cooler heads ____.
My lawyer suggested that I ____ sign the document until he reviews it. (Subjuntivo negativo).
Every quarter, the company pays a $5 ____ to anyone who owns its stock.
The introduction of the internet caused a massive ____ shift in the media industry.
I know you hate the marketing director, but you need to bury the ____ and work together on this project.
If you buy an asset for $100 and sell it for $300, you have to pay taxes on your $200 capital ____.
The investors will give you $5 million, but they want to know your ____ strategy. How will they get their money back?
Just to play ____'s advocate: what if the AI takes our jobs faster than we think?
To completely close a company, fire everyone, and sell all the assets to pay debts is to ____ the company.
If we launch a cheap version of our software, it might destroy the sales of our premium version. This is called ____.
We disagree on many things, but surely we can find common ____ regarding the safety regulations.
The judge ordered that the documents ____ destroyed immediately. (Subjuntivo pasivo).
In a saturated market, gaining a customer means a competitor loses one. It's a ____-sum game.
I demand that he ____. (Subjuntivo de resign)
It is vital that she ____ informed. (Subjuntivo de to be)
A ____ market. (Mercado bajista con B)
Government ____. (Rescate financiero con B)
A ____-sum game. (Suma cero con Z)
____ competency. (Competencia principal con C)
____ the situation. (Desescalar con D)
Let cooler heads ____. (Prevalecer con P)
Bury the ____. (Hacer las paces con H)
A ____ shift. (Cambio de paradigma con P)
